boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten library-based work settings with documented study functions, ranging from collaborative lower-level space to designated quiet-study floors.

cards.title: Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Lower Level, W. E. B. Du Bois Library
cards.notes: Set up in the lower-level commons when you need printers, a service desk, cell-phone booths, or a group-study setting in the same stop.
cards.short_summary: A service-rich lower-level workspace for collaborative work and quick campus tasks.
cards.evidence_claim: The Du Bois Library floor directory lists the Learning Commons on the Lower Level with group study, a service desk, cell-phone booths, and printers.
cards.source_title: W. E. B. Du Bois Library Floor Directory
cards.access_notes: Located on the Lower Level of the W. E. B. Du Bois Library; consult the library for current building access.

cards.title: Floor 2 Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: Floor 2, W. E. B. Du Bois Library
cards.notes: Choose this designated quiet area for reading or focused laptop work; lockers and cell-phone booths are listed on the same floor.
cards.short_summary: A quiet-study floor with nearby lockers and call booths.
cards.evidence_claim: The Du Bois Library floor directory identifies Floor 2 as Quiet Study and lists lockers and cell-phone booths there.
cards.source_title: W. E. B. Du Bois Library Floor Directory
cards.access_notes: Floor 2 of the W. E. B. Du Bois Library; public lockers require key checkout under library rules.

cards.title: Floor 5 Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: Floor 5, W. E. B. Du Bois Library
cards.notes: Use the quiet-study portion of Floor 5 for concentrated work, with printers and lockers documented on the floor.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet area with printing and locker access nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: The Du Bois Library floor directory lists Quiet Study, lockers, and printers on Floor 5.
cards.source_title: W. E. B. Du Bois Library Floor Directory
cards.access_notes: Floor 5 also contains the Graduate Commons, which has separate UCard access requirements.

cards.title: Floor 8 Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: Floor 8, W. E. B. Du Bois Library
cards.notes: Take a reading-heavy session to this quiet-study floor, where the directory also places the K and P–PQ5999 book stacks.
cards.short_summary: Quiet study beside the library’s K and P–PQ5999 collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The Du Bois Library floor directory designates Floor 8 for Quiet Study and lists book stacks K and P–PQ5999.
cards.source_title: W. E. B. Du Bois Library Floor Directory
cards.access_notes: Floor 8 of the W. E. B. Du Bois Library; consult the library for current building access.

cards.title: Floor 11 Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: Floor 11, W. E. B. Du Bois Library
cards.notes: Bring a book or drafting task to the quiet-study area on Floor 11, adjacent to the PQ6000–PT stacks.
cards.short_summary: A quiet floor paired with literature and language stacks.
cards.evidence_claim: The Du Bois Library floor directory identifies Floor 11 as Quiet Study and lists the PQ6000–PT book stacks.
cards.source_title: W. E. B. Du Bois Library Floor Directory
cards.access_notes: Floor 11 of the W. E. B. Du Bois Library; consult the library for current building access.

cards.title: Floor 14 Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: Floor 14, W. E. B. Du Bois Library
cards.notes: Use Floor 14’s designated quiet-study area for independent work while keeping the DS–F book stacks within the same floor.
cards.short_summary: Independent-study space among history and social-science collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The Du Bois Library floor directory lists Floor 14 as Quiet Study with book stacks DS–F.
cards.source_title: W. E. B. Du Bois Library Floor Directory
cards.access_notes: Floor 14 of the W. E. B. Du Bois Library; consult the library for current building access.

cards.title: Floor 17 Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: Floor 17, W. E. B. Du Bois Library
cards.notes: Work quietly on Floor 17 and pull needed materials from the A, HG2000–HZ, and J collections listed there.
cards.short_summary: A quiet-study level near broad humanities and business-related stacks.
cards.evidence_claim: The Du Bois Library floor directory designates Floor 17 for Quiet Study and lists book stacks A, HG2000–HZ, and J.
cards.source_title: W. E. B. Du Bois Library Floor Directory
cards.access_notes: Floor 17 of the W. E. B. Du Bois Library; consult the library for current building access.

cards.title: Floor 20 Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: Floor 20, W. E. B. Du Bois Library
cards.notes: Settle into the quiet-study area on Floor 20 when thesis or dissertation research calls for nearby B and L collections.
cards.short_summary: Quiet study with theses, dissertations, and B/L stacks on the floor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Du Bois Library floor directory lists Floor 20 as Quiet Study with B and L stacks and theses and dissertations.
cards.source_title: W. E. B. Du Bois Library Floor Directory
cards.access_notes: Floor 20 of the W. E. B. Du Bois Library; consult the library for current building access.

cards.entity_name: Science & Engineering Library Third-Floor Study Area
cards.title: SEL Third-Floor Study Area
cards.subtitle: Science & Engineering Library, Lederle Graduate Research Center Lowrise
cards.notes: Use the library’s largest dedicated study area when rolling whiteboards and tables would help you organize a problem set or project.
cards.short_summary: A large STEM-library study area with tables, chairs, and rolling whiteboards.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Libraries describes SEL’s third floor as its largest area dedicated to study, with rolling whiteboards, tables, and chairs.
cards.access_notes: Inside the Science & Engineering Library at Lederle Graduate Research Center Lowrise; verify current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: SEL Learning Studio
cards.subtitle: Science & Engineering Library, second floor
cards.notes: Check whether instruction or an event is scheduled; when it is unoccupied, this presentation-capable room is available for study.
cards.short_summary: An open-study setting that also supports instruction and presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Libraries states that the SEL Learning Studio is an instruction, presentation, and open-study environment available for study when not occupied.
cards.access_notes: Available only when not occupied for information-literacy instruction or another event.
